_note: C6 joints and fasteners: local specification values (hardware dimensions from the ISO standards, torques and rules chosen by C6). Read by team/C6/joints.py as P:joints.*. Revision C6-R3 (params A1-R4, D-50, D-58). Shared numbers come from params/params.json and the subsystem params; loads come from C1 claims. Frame and units: params.json#frame, SI.

m3_d_m.note: every bought structural fastener is M3 (one thread, one 2.5 mm hex key)

nyloc_protrusion_min_threads.note: bolt end at least 2 pitches past the nyloc nut

insert_len_m.source: Ruthex RX-M3x5.7 / CNC Kitchen M3 standard insert
insert_len_m.note: hole 4.0 mm, blind depth >= engagement + 0.5 mm, boss wall >= 1.6 mm

insert_engage_min_d.note: x d into a heat-set insert; 1.0 d into metal; 2.0 d self-tapping into plastic

motor_screw_nm.note: M3 into the aluminium motor base, head on a printed plate, no washer; 4 N (0.41 kg) on a luggage scale hooked 50 mm out on the hex key

insert_nm.note: M3 into a brass heat-set insert in PETG; insert torque-out is several times higher

printed_max_nm.note: ceiling for any M3 whose head or nut bears on a printed part

nylon_m3_nm.note: PA66 M3 into a brass insert: 1.6 N on a luggage scale 50 mm out on the hex key, or fingertip-snug on a PH1 until the washer stops turning; replaces F1's 0.20 N m (install RF 0.67 at 0.20). No threadlocker on nylon

strip_bonded_faces_now.note: R3: both strip faces bond to PETG in the 40 mm two-face tail (tongue between the strips)

fillet_leg_m.note: microballoon-epoxy fillet leg in the pod floor-to-side-wall corner under the strap

stack_m.note: clamped length above the insert face

spacer_m.source: subsystems/power/interfaces.json E-PWR-03 (nylon spacer OD 6 / ID 3.2 / 10 mm)

collar_alt_h_m.source: subsystems/fins/params.json R3 (16 mm ring); CHANGE-LOG D-48
collar_alt_h_m.note: fallback height if T-C6-LAP-PETG comes in below 2.0 MPa design: D3 drew 12 mm at R4 (D-48); the drawn height is fin_detail.station_collar.height_m

root_fillet_leg_m.note: half-fin root microballoon fillet leg, both faces; D3 still draws 12 mm (ASM-D3-FILLET-LEG)

pin_pitch_prop_m.note: strip through-pin pitch proposed to D3 (drawn 15 mm) at C4's 64 N pin force
